title: 3 1950'S GLASS LIGHT SHADES
reason: Three Art Deco style glass shades (stepped opal skyscraper, ribbed cream cone, fluted yellow globe), unmarked but a collected lighting style that may be older than the title says; about $30 to $70 each.
findings: One photo, three unmarked glass shades: (1) a white opal stepped octagonal shade in an Art Deco 'skyscraper' style on a chrome fitter ring; (2) a cream and clear conical shade with vertical ribbed bands and a moulded clear top; (3) a butterscotch or custard yellow globe with a fluted upper half. No maker's marks or moulded numbers visible. The stepped opal style is Art Deco derived and could be 1930s to 1950s, so it may be older than the 1950s in the title.
condition: No chips or cracks seen. The chrome fitter on the white shade is dull with brown and green spotting; yellow globe has minor marks. Working suitability of the fitters unknown.
rescore_note: Three unmarked Deco style glass shades (stepped opal octagonal, ribbed cream cone, fluted yellow globe), tidy and collectable but common types; my estimate about $50 to $80 for the three (no live comps).
